body:
Awesome work @LukyVj it looks so good! 👏

I have some remarks:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/893837/27446912-5e28f5d2-577f-11e7-8a4c-0dc280e4cfa6.png) 
It looks like the whole button should be clickable?

 ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/893837/27447175-5ac41b1e-5780-11e7-917d-d64fa15e9e71.png) 
Did you tried with a white hover text color?


![jun-22-2017 19-25-59](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/893837/27447289-b4f15674-5780-11e7-85f2-b53f0a820956.gif) 
The left side menu has a scrollbar inside itself and does not take the full height space of the page

---

* We lost the syntax color into code examples.
* The get started CTA is only the third one, I expect from a documentation website to be almost the first thing visible to encourage users to start coding!
* I think the get started link does not fit with the no framework needed block but more with the widgets one.

And again thank's a it's so much better <3
If you need any help for anything just ask!
